description: This file defines a class 'quality_test' for performing object quality checks in an Odoo module, including validation of fields, views, security rules, and dependencies.

classes.name: quality_test
classes.description: A class for performing quality checks on Odoo modules, including validation of fields, views, security rules, and dependencies.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the quality_test class with name, note, installed-only flag, and minimum score.

methods.name: run_test
methods.description: Executes the quality test, checking fields, views, security rules, and dependencies, and calculates a score.

methods.name: get_result
methods.description: Generates a formatted table of test results for fields, views, security, and dependencies.

methods.name: get_result_details
methods.description: Creates detailed HTML report of field validation results.

methods.name: get_result_general
methods.description: Creates summarized HTML report for views, security, or dependencies.
